items.title: Making the generic fibre geometrically reduced by a finite universal homeomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Over an irreducible base and for a finite type morphism, the lemma constructs a diagram in which a nonempty open of the base is replaced by a finite universal homeomorphism and the base-changed morphism is replaced by its reduction, such that the new morphism is flat and of finite presentation with geometrically reduced generic fibre. The proof passes to the reduction, which makes the generic fibre geometrically reduced by construction, and then verifies that the reduction map is a finite universal homeomorphism and that flatness and finite presentation hold over the chosen open. Combining the reduction with the flatness condition is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 6742-6769.
